== <span style="text-shadow: 1.5px 0.66px 2px blue, -1.5px 0.66px 2px blue; color: black;">Description</span> ==
'''D-180i''' is an Admin exclusive entity. It works basically like [[SHA-180]], but rebounds much more and can spawn more entities...

== <span style="text-shadow: 1.5px 0.66px 2px blue, -1.5px 0.66px 2px blue; color: black;">Behavior</span> ==
When '''D-180i''' spawn, it will emmit subtitles saying "<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px blue; color: blue;">Psst. Hey, {User}</span>" "<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px blue; color: blue;">I know what you have planned. I know your intentions better than you do.</span>" "<span style="text-shadow: 0 0 5px blue; color: blue;">I'm coming for you. Better run while you still can. I'm already on my way.</span>"

Upon approaximating the main room '''D-180i''' will start filling all player's screen with static, emmiting a silent noise upon reaching very closely to the main room. As '''D-180i''' hit the door, it will fallback and start a random rebound cycle (11-44 rebounds).

Each time '''D-180i''' rushes to the main room and hits the door, it will spawn a random D-Section entity (or A-Section).

These are all the entities '''D-180i''' can spawn:

* [[D-5]] (?)
* [[D-5i]]
* [[D-20i]]
* [[A-20i]]
* [[D-35i]]
* [[D-55]]
* [[D-55ii]] (?)
* [[D-60i]] (Old version only)
* [[D-120]]
* [[D-140]]
* [[D-140i]] (Old version only)
* [[D-200]]
* [[A-60i]]
* [[A-200i]]
So basically, '''D-180i''' can spawn almost all entities form [[Section D|D section]], but also i variants from other sections (Only [[Section A|A section]] for now).

== <span style="text-shadow: 1.5px 0.66px 2px blue, -1.5px 0.66px 2px blue; color: black;">Strategy & Tips</span> ==
* As '''D-180i''' rush to the main room without any spawn clue, if you start seeing your screen get full of static, immediately hide.
* If '''D-180i''' spawn [[A-200i]] you don't need to worry for '''D-180i''' because he wait [[A-200i]] to depsawn first before continuing to rebound. (This is obvious because you wouldn't even be able to detect him with the [[A-200i]]'s static).
* Unlike the other minibosses Admin variants, '''D-180i''' does NOT require you to open doors to make him despawn, so it's best to just wait him to despawn.
* Always hide in '''Blue Heavy Lockers''' or '''White Cabinets''' when '''D-180i''' is spawned, because if he spawn [[D-55ii]], you won't have time to unhide and move to the determinated Locker/Cabinet.
* '''D-180i''' cannot locker snipe, use this as your advantage and hide in last second to avoid getting damage from [[Claustrophobia]].

== <span style="text-shadow: 1.5px 0.66px 2px blue, -1.5px 0.66px 2px blue; color: black;">Trivia</span> ==
* '''D-180i''' is actually called '''Joke D-180''', but most people call him '''D-180i''' because he acts like a Prime variant,
* If '''D-180i''' spawns [[D-5i]], he will either wait for [[D-5i]] to despawn, or he will despawn instead.
* <big>'''D-180i''' knows your intentions, so run from him.</big>
* Unlike [[D-180]], '''D-180i''' is calm, and will play fair with the player, waiting for entities like [[D-5i]] to despawn first, then continue attacking.
* '''D-180i''' is not friendly and not agressive with the players, he is just neutral, but even through he is a lot more dangerous than [[D-180]].
* '''D-180i''' prefers to kill the most experienced/skilled players first, as he loves to see good players suffering to survive so many entities, and also to see who long they will last.
* Players who survive '''D-180i''' will be marked and '''D-180i''' will never forget them.
